what: Interface to JDemetra+ Seasonal Adjustment Software
title: Interface to JDemetra+ Seasonal Adjustment Software
text: RJDemetra R interface JDemetra+, seasonal adjustment software officially recommended members European Statistical System (ESS) European System Central Banks. JDemetra+ implements two leading seasonal adjustment methods TRAMO/SEATS+ X-12ARIMA/X-13ARIMA-SEATS. Besides seasonal adjustment, JDemetra+ bundles time series models useful production analysis economic statistics, including instance outlier detection, nowcasting, temporal disaggregation benchmarking. details JDemetra+ software see https://github.com/jdemetra/jdemetra-app. RJDemetra offers full access options outputs JDemetra+.
